description: Table with Custom and Grouped Headers by JTA - a Data Scientist's Visualization Tool Transform Your Power BI Tables – Structure, Simplify, Succeed! Overview Take your Power BI tables to the next level with Table with Custom Headers by JTA, a powerful custom visual that enhances data presentation and organization. This visual allows you to create structured tables while grouping columns under custom headers that act like categories, improving readability and making complex datasets easier to analyze. Key Features: Custom Header Grouping: Organize column headers into general and sub headers for better structure. Hierarchical Row Display: Present rows in a hierarchical format and control which levels to collapse or expand. Flexible Column Organization: Group columns under sub headers and main headers for improved clarity. Adjustable Header Visibility: Hide general headers while keeping sub headers visible. Table Totals Display: Show or hide totals for better summarization. Advanced Formatting Options: Customize background and font colors for specific headers. Display Unit Formatting: Adjust numerical values to suit your reporting needs. If you liked what you saw, you can try it for yourself! Try it here. If you have any doubts reach out to custom.visuals@thedatascientists.com.
